questions.question: What does a flashing yellow light mean?

options.text: Stop and look for other vehicles, then go if the road is clear.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Speed up to get through the intersection quickly.
Slow down and proceed carefully.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed carefully.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means you should slow down and proceed with caution.

questions.question: What does a speed restriction sign show?

options.text: It can be ignored when it is raining, snowing, or icy.
It has a triangle shape.
It is blue with black letters.
It shows a safe speed for a curve or turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: It shows a safe speed for a curve or turn.
questions.explanation: Signs on curves and turns show a recommended speed for those areas. You should follow the recommended speed even in good weather. In rain, snow, or ice, you should drive even slower than the recommended speed.

questions.question: You want to turn left at an intersection with a green light, but traffic is coming from the other direction. What should you do?

options.text: Use the next intersection instead.
Wait at the edge of the road for traffic to clear.
Wait in the middle of the intersection for traffic to clear.
Turn because you have the green light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait in the middle of the intersection for traffic to clear.
questions.explanation: You can enter the intersection when the light is green to prepare for your left turn. Wait in the middle of the intersection until oncoming traffic passes, then complete your turn.

questions.question: When should you use your headlights?

options.text: When you cannot see 1,000 feet ahead.
When you cannot see 500 feet ahead.
When you cannot see 300 feet ahead.
When you cannot see 200 feet ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you cannot see 1,000 feet ahead.
questions.explanation: Turn on your headlights whenever weather or other conditions prevent you from seeing at least 1,000 feet in front of your vehicle.

questions.question: An oncoming car is heading toward you in your lane. What should you do?

options.text: Honk your horn, steer right, and speed up.
Honk your horn, steer left, and brake.
Honk your horn, steer right, and brake.
Stay in your lane, honk your horn, and brake.

questions.correctAnswerText: Honk your horn, steer right, and brake.
questions.explanation: First, honk your horn to get the other driver's attention. If they do not move, steer to the right to escape. Do not steer left because the other driver might also steer left at the last second, causing a crash. Always brake firmly to reduce the impact.

questions.question: When are roads most slippery?

options.text: After it has been raining for an hour or longer.
The day after rain.
During the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain.
Right after rain stops.

questions.correctAnswerText: During the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain.
questions.explanation: Roads are most slippery during the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain. The rain brings oil from the asphalt to the surface, making it very slippery. This problem is worse in hot weather.

questions.question: Why should you be careful when passing a bicycle?

options.text: You are moving faster than the bicycle.
The bicycle always has the right-of-way.
Oncoming traffic may not see you pass the bicycle.
The cyclist may swerve into traffic to avoid an obstacle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The cyclist may swerve into traffic to avoid an obstacle.
questions.explanation: Be careful when passing a bicycle because the cyclist may suddenly swerve into traffic to avoid something on the road. Always drive carefully near bicycles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the road.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.
There is a merge ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: This chevron sign shows the road is curving sharply in the direction the arrow points. In this case, the road curves to the left. You may see several of these signs throughout a curve.

questions.question: You reach an intersection that is blocked by traffic. What should you do?

options.text: Go slowly until the traffic ahead moves.
Get as close as possible to the car in front.
Stay out of the intersection until you can pass through completely.
Honk your horn to make cars move forward.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay out of the intersection until you can pass through completely.
questions.explanation: Do not enter an intersection if you cannot pass completely through it. Wait until the traffic ahead clears so you do not block the intersection.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?

options.text: Turn left.
Turn right.
Stop.
Go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn right.
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm points upward, they are signaling they will turn right. Adjust your driving if you are following a driver using this signal.

questions.question: What traffic light means you must stop, yield to other traffic and pedestrians, then go when safe?

options.text: A solid red light.
A flashing yellow light.
A solid green light.
A flashing red light.

questions.correctAnswerText: A flashing red light.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. You must stop completely. Yield to traffic and pedestrians. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: Is it safe to use cruise control on snowy or icy roads if you reduce your speed?

options.text: True
False

questions.correctAnswerText: False
questions.explanation: Do not use cruise control on snowy or icy roads. Your tires may lose grip and you will lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: When parking uphill on a hill with a curb, which way should you turn your wheels?

options.text: Turn your front wheels sharply toward the curb.
Turn your front wheels slightly to the right.
Turn your front wheels sharply away from the curb.
Keep your front wheels straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your front wheels sharply away from the curb.
questions.explanation: Turn your wheels sharply away from the curb when parking uphill. This stops your car from rolling into traffic if your brakes fail.

questions.question: A fully loaded tractor-trailer at 55 mph needs about how many feet to stop?

options.text: 50 feet
125 feet
400 feet
750 feet

questions.correctAnswerText: 400 feet
questions.explanation: Trucks need much more distance to stop than cars at the same speed. A fully loaded truck at 55 mph needs about 400 feet to stop.

questions.question: Which statement about motorcycles is true?

options.text: It is okay for drivers to follow motorcycles closely.
A motorcycle is more balanced with two riders than one.
You must change lanes completely when passing a motorcycle.
Motorcycle brake lights turn on whenever the rider slows down.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must change lanes completely when passing a motorcycle.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles need a full lane. Move completely into the left lane before passing a motorcycle.

questions.question: Your accelerator gets stuck while you are driving on a busy street. What should you do?

options.text: Blow your horn.
Slam on your brakes.
Turn on your four-way flashers.
Turn off your ignition carefully without locking the steering wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn off your ignition carefully without locking the steering wheel.
questions.explanation: If your accelerator sticks, turn off the ignition carefully. Move the switch just enough to stop the engine without locking the steering wheel. Then apply your brakes and pull to a safe spot.

questions.question: What color are most warning signs?

options.text: Red.
Yellow.
Green.
Blue.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yellow.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They warn you about conditions you may not see right away.

questions.question: On a road with no sidewalk, where should a pedestrian walk?

options.text: On the side with the lightest traffic.
On the same side that traffic is moving.
On the side facing oncoming traffic.
On the side with the heaviest traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: On the side facing oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: Pedestrians should walk on the side facing the traffic coming toward them.

questions.question: If your car does not have ABS and you need to stop fast, what should you do?

options.text: Hold down the brake pedal.
Pump your brakes firmly.
Tap the brakes lightly.
Release the brake pedal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pump your brakes firmly.
questions.explanation: Pumping the brakes is the best way to stop in an emergency. Your car stops quickly and you can still steer.

questions.question: When should you slow down when exiting a highway?

options.text: On the main road, just before the exit lane.
Once you see a toll booth.
Once you have moved into the exit lane.
When you first see the exit sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Once you have moved into the exit lane.
questions.explanation: Get into the exit lane early. Do not slow down until after you are in the exit lane.

questions.question: You must yield to other drivers:

options.text: When entering a street from a garage or alley.
When they are on a road to your left and you reach an unmarked intersection at the same time.
When your traffic signal is a green arrow.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: When entering a street from a garage or alley.
questions.explanation: You must yield to other drivers when entering a street from an alley, driveway, or garage. You must also yield to pedestrians on an intersecting sidewalk.

questions.question: When driving on slippery roads:

options.text: Always drive at the maximum speed limit.
Use cruise control to maintain a steady speed.
Reduce your following distance.
Do not make sudden changes in speed or direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not make sudden changes in speed or direction.
questions.explanation: Avoid sudden changes in speed or direction on slippery surfaces. Slow down on slippery roads and do not use cruise control.

questions.question: When driving in fog, use your high beam headlights.

options.text: TRUE
FALSE

questions.correctAnswerText: FALSE
questions.explanation: Use your low beam headlights in fog. High beams reflect off fog and shine back into your eyes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn ahead, slow down.
Work crew ahead.
Side road.
Playground ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp turn ahead, slow down.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a sharp turn ahead and tells drivers to slow down.

questions.question: Guide signs are ____ signs that show directions and distances to drivers.

options.text: Yellow
Red
Green
White

questions.correctAnswerText: Green
questions.explanation: Guide signs have a green background and show directions and distances to specific places. They help drivers navigate unfamiliar roads.
